notes: This source/test traceability contract covers only the bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 region specification lifecycle in Umbra's opt-in, non-installable development profile. The profile creates private region templates from composed 1516.2-2025 dimensions, retains pending range updates until a complete commit, validates ranges against FOM dimension upper bounds, exposes the official support lookups, and deletes unused regions owned by the caller. Region realizations, associations, subscriptions, overlap routing, timestamped/retraction behavior, save/restore, remote transport, package support, catalog evidence, and conformance remain outside this slice. The contract uses immutable candidate IDs exported by the Requirements Lab, including its current source-title path mismatch.
